subject: spellcaster rarity
fact: Spellcasters who can cast mending are rare due to naval combat tactics.
source_quote: spell casters who could cast mending were in high demand by the navies. And so spellcasters tended to avoid learning that spell. See, in naval combat, the first person you kill is the mender. Because until you kill him, you can’t sink the ship. So finding a spell caster who can cast it is rare.
